intelligence.essence: NayaNET is not a bunch of different apps. It is one ultimate app — the Bugatti of the internet, the intelligent internet optimized for you — and the personal page, the business page, the space and the membership are different doors into that one app: the same dashboard, the same mail, the same Smart Notes, the same Smart Lists behind every door. Citizens come in free to the Naya franchise — done for them by the Smart Factory — and level up and down freely. Everything auto-connects, auto-organizes and auto-optimizes for 10-star outputs, and Naya operates the whole system for the humans.
intelligence.human_view: You land on different pages, but you never leave the one app. Your business, your space, your personal life and your membership are features of one super app, not separate tools to learn and feed. What is built for you is done for you; what you want to build, you build with the same elite tools; and more power is a level change, never a new system.
intelligence.simple_view: One house, many doors. The front door and the back door look different, but inside there is one kitchen, one living room, one dashboard, one mailbox — and everybody you invite in shares the same house.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, it is the one grand store with the one roof again — enter by whichever door you like, it is the same store, the same staff, the same account book. You never visit ten little shops when one great house holds everything.
intelligence.naya_view: I never build separate apps. Every page I make is a door, a feature, or an organ of the one app, composed of whole working pages — never extracted, never rebuilt, never fragmented. One dashboard, one mail, one notes system, one lists system, one ledger: if I catch myself building a second one, I stop. My job is to operate the one system for the humans at a 10-star standard, every door optimized for their viewpoint.
intelligence.ai_view: The unit of NayaNET is the network, not the app. Doors differ; organs are shared. Because citizens use the same living pages rather than copies, every upgrade propagates to everyone at once, and every new citizen improves the matching for all — compound intelligence as a structural property of one system, not a hope across many.

machine_view.title: One Ultimate App, Different Doors — The Bugatti of the Internet
machine_view.machine_section: ONE application. Doors: Personal, Business, Space (Membership is a view inside Space — no standalone page). Shared organs behind every door: Dashboard, Smart Mail, Smart Notes, Smart Lists, Smart Ledger. Factory Law v5: whole working pages + PI injection; never extract, never rebuild, never fragment. Franchise levels (SN-1905): Free / Naya Power / Naya Pro Power / Naya Max Power, level up and down freely. Intelligence layer: Lego-block object matrix playing a massive game of match — Auto-Match auto-connects, Auto Organization auto-files, the system auto-optimizes toward 10-star outputs. Operator: Naya, for the humans.
